paragraphs.text: Junk-food lovers who try to cut back on fries or chocolate may experience symptoms similar to drug withdrawal, a new study suggests.

sentences.text: Junk-food lovers who try to cut back on fries or chocolate may experience symptoms similar to drug withdrawal, a new study suggests.

analysis.translationLiteral: 试图少吃薯条或巧克力的垃圾食品爱好者，可能会出现与药物戒断相似的症状，一项新研究提示。
analysis.translationNatural: 一项新研究提醒：想戒掉薯条、巧克力这类垃圾食品的人，身上可能出现类似「戒断反应」的症状。
analysis.structMarkup: 【Junk-food lovers who try to cut back on fries or chocolate】 _may experience symptoms_ (similar to drug withdrawal), (a new study suggests).
analysis.structureSummary: 主语 Junk-food lovers（后接 who 定语从句）+ 情态谓语 may experience + 宾语 symptoms + 形容词短语 similar to drug withdrawal 作后置定语，句末 a new study suggests 为评注性插入分句；核心是用 similar to 把「减吃垃圾食品」类比成「药物戒断」。

components.part: Junk-food lovers who try to cut back on fries or chocolate

components.part: who try to cut back on fries or chocolate

components.part: may experience symptoms
components.note: 情态动词 may + 动词原形 experience + 宾语 symptoms，用 may 表示「可能」而非必然，给结论留有余地。

components.note: 形容词短语后置修饰 symptoms，把「症状」与 drug withdrawal（药物戒断）挂钩，是全篇立论的关键类比。

components.part: a new study suggests
components.note: 置于句末的评注性主谓分句，交代结论来自新研究；抽掉后主句仍自足，是新闻体常见的信源后置写法。

clauses: 定语从句「who try to cut back on fries or chocolate」：who 修饰 lovers；cut back on 意为「削减、减少摄入」，or 连接 fries 与 chocolate 两个并列宾语，点明被削减的对象。

phrases.usage: 注意区分：experience（经验，不可数）/ experiences（经历，可数）。常见搭配：work experience / a lot of experience。

analysis.paragraphRole: 开篇用一项新研究抛出全文总命题——减少垃圾食品会引发类似戒断的症状，为后文的研究发现与意义逐层展开定调。

paragraphs.text: Researchers found that people attempting to cut down on eating highly processed foods experience some of the same 26 and psychological symptoms—such as mood swings, anxiety, headaches and poor sleep—as those 27 smoking cigarettes or using drugs, according to the study.

sentences.text: Researchers found that people attempting to cut down on eating highly processed foods experience some of the same 26 and psychological symptoms—such as mood swings, anxiety, headaches and poor sleep—as those 27 smoking cigarettes or using drugs, according to the study.

analysis.translationLiteral: 研究人员发现，那些试图减少吃高度加工食品的人，会体验到与那些 27 吸烟或使用毒品的人相同的一些 26 及心理症状——比如情绪波动、焦虑、头痛和睡眠不佳——根据这项研究。
analysis.translationNatural: 研究称，想少吃高度加工食品的人，会出现和戒烟、戒毒者如出一辙的身心反应：情绪起伏、焦虑、头痛、睡不好，一个不少。
analysis.structMarkup: 【Researchers】 _found_ {that people attempting to cut down on eating highly processed foods experience some of the same 26 and psychological symptoms—such as mood swings, anxiety, headaches and poor sleep—as those 27 smoking cigarettes or using drugs}, (according to the study).
analysis.structureSummary: 主句 Researchers found + that 宾语从句；从句主干为 people（后接现在分词后置定语）experience some of the same 26 and psychological symptoms，破折号内 such as... 为举例插入语，as those 27... 与 the same 构成 the same...as 比较结构；句末 according to the study 交代来源。26 需与 psychological 并列的形容词、27 需动名词。

components.part: Researchers

components.part: found
components.note: 主句限定动词，后接 that 引导的宾语从句，说明「发现」到的具体内容。

components.part: that people attempting to cut down on eating highly processed foods experience some of the same 26 and psychological symptoms—such as mood swings, anxiety, headaches and poor sleep—as those 27 smoking cigarettes or using drugs
components.note: that 引导作 found 的宾语；用 the same...as... 把「减吃加工食品者」与「戒烟 / 戒毒者」的症状等同起来，两个破折号之间为举例插入成分，26、27 为待填空白。

components.part: attempting to cut down on eating highly processed foods
components.note: 现在分词短语修饰 people，相当于 who attempt to...；cut down on 意为「减少」，highly processed foods 指「深度加工食品」。

components.part: some of the same 26 and psychological symptoms
components.note: experience 的宾语，也是 the same...as 结构的前项；26 空须填形容词与 psychological 并列，合指「身体与心理两方面症状」。

components.part: —such as mood swings, anxiety, headaches and poor sleep—
components.note: 一对破折号括起的举例成分，具体列出情绪波动、焦虑、头痛、睡眠差；去掉后主句骨架不受影响。

components.part: as those 27 smoking cigarettes or using drugs
components.note: 与前面的 the same 呼应构成比较结构，引出被类比的另一群人；27 空须填动名词 quitting，与 smoking、using 一起修饰 those。

components.part: according to the study
components.note: 句末介词短语作评注性状语，回指首段 a new study suggests，标明信息来源。

clauses: 宾语从句「that people attempting to cut down on eating highly processed foods ex」：that 引导作 found 的宾语；用 the same...as... 把「减吃加工食品者」与「戒烟 / 戒毒者」的症状等同起来，两个破折号之间为举例插入成分，26、27 为待填空白。
that 引导宾语从句，作前面动词的宾语，从句用陈述语序。
逗号后的现在分词短语作伴随状语或补充说明，逻辑主语与主句主语一致。

phrases.meaning: 根据、据……所说
phrases.usage: 引出信息来源，后接名词或代词，不接从句。
phrases.example: According to the report, costs rose. 据报告，成本上升了。

phrases.meaning: 同样的
phrases.usage: same 前通常有 the；the same as 表「与……相同」。
phrases.example: The same thing happened last year. 去年也发生了同样的事。

phrases.meaning: 例如
phrases.usage: 后接名词性成分列举，不能独立成句。
phrases.example: Sports such as running are popular. 像跑步这类运动很受欢迎。

same 前一般要加 the；比较对象用 as 不用 with。
such as 用于举例，for example 常作插入语，位置不同。
宾语从句用陈述语序，不要把助动词提到主语前。
analysis.paragraphRole: 承接首段，用研究者的具体发现把「垃圾食品戒断」坐实：症状与戒烟戒毒者高度重合，并借 26、27 两空考查形容词与动名词。

paragraphs.text: The new study 28 the first evidence that these withdrawal-like symptoms can occur when people cut down on highly processed foods, said lead study author Erica Schulte.

sentences.text: The new study 28 the first evidence that these withdrawal-like symptoms can occur when people cut down on highly processed foods, said lead study author Erica Schulte.

analysis.translationLiteral: 这项新研究 28 首批证据，证明当人们减少高度加工食品时，这些类似戒断的症状可能出现，首席研究作者 Erica Schulte 说。

sentences.text: Based on the participants' self-reported symptoms, withdrawal symptoms were 29 more intense between the second and fifth days after attempting to reduce junk-food consumption, which 30 the time span people live through during drug withdrawal.

paragraphs.text: The idea that food may be addictive after "heavy" use by some individuals is a 31 subject, Schulte said. Although prior studies in animals and humans have shown some biological and behavioral similarities between substance-use disorders and addictive-like consumption of highly processed foods, no studies have looked at whether reducing junk food can 32 withdrawal symptoms in people, she noted. Raising 33 that people may experience irritability(烦躁) or headaches when cutting down on junk food can help individuals 34 coping strategies in advance, Schulte noted. The findings may also 35 light on the barriers people face when changing eating habits—barriers that may play a role in people dropping out of treatments, she said.

sentences.text: The idea that food may be addictive after "heavy" use by some individuals is a 31 subject, Schulte said.

analysis.translationLiteral: 「食物在被某些人大量食用后可能成瘾」这一观点，是一个 31 话题，Schulte 说。

clauses: 同位语从句「that food may be addictive after "heavy" use by some individuals」：that 从句与 idea 同位，展开其内容；after "heavy" use 中引号表示「大量 / 重度」使用的特殊含义，by some individuals 点明仅限部分人。
